title: Update 20.0
cats: Articles using infobox templates with no data rows
html:
Update 20.0, previously named update 0.20.0, got deployed in 2025 on March 19/20th (depends on your timezone), adding various new features.

New Features

Maps & Territories

  • North America map got lakes, rivers, more bots, and a larger size.
  • Africa map got lakes, rivers, and more bots.
  • Gateway to the Atlantic map added
  • All 50 US State flags can be picked as player flags
  • 24 British and Irish Nation flags

Combat & Military

  • Warships don't heal or capture trade ships when their owning player has no port.
  • All units have a slightly faster attack speed
  • Medium and big players have a higher attack speed, and the opposite for huge players.
  • SAM sites now have faster missiles, circular range instead of square, and a slightly faster attack rate.
  • SAM sites also have a 75% interception likelihood for nukes and hydrogen bombs and turn red while reloading

UI & Graphics

  • When hovering over a country, you get detailed information towards the top right of your screen, which includes number of attacking troops, cities, and missile launchers.
  • SAM Sites now appear thicker on the map with slightly different border colors.
  • Colorized map thumbnails are back
  • Fixed water depth/darkness gradient from coastlines.

Stability & Fixes

  • Identified and fixed issue with lobbies not starting when max players exceeded.

Miscellaneous

  • Integrated colorized thumbnail creation to map creation scripts

List of Contributors

Thanks to everyone that contributed to this new version!
